description: This file defines a PHP class 'MyTimesheetItemAPI' that extends 'EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI'. It appears to implement API endpoints for retrieving and updating a user's timesheet entries, including Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation. Key methods involve fetching timesheet data by ID, with role and existence checks.

classes.name: MyTimesheetItemAPI
